title: I Have Faith for You
summary: Sometimes we need to run on the faith of others. That is what the church and friends are for. What Jesus started, he will finish.
exhortation: Are you sure this morning? One of the things my dad would say to people who were discouraged and losing faith was, "I know you may not have much faith right now, but I have faith for you." Sometimes we just need to run on the faith of others. That's what the church is for, and that's what friends are for.

Are you losing faith? Well, I've got faith for you. Remember the promises of Jesus. What he started, he will complete. He's coming back one day. He didn't promise that we could do it. He promised that he would do it.

So my encouragement this morning: phone a friend. Call a brother or sister, tell them you need some help, and ask if you can borrow some faith to get through the day. You don't have to do it alone. Jesus is with us every step of the way, and one of the things he uses in our lives is the brothers and sisters around us. And if you're doing great, pick someone, give them a call and encourage them. We all need it more than we know.
prayer: Lord, thank you for this time of worship together. Be our strength today. Lift our faith through the faith of others in the church, and thank you for giving us such a wonderful church.
Comfort our hearts, deliver us today in the ways we need, and guard and protect us. Thank you for your strength, God. In Jesus' name, amen.
